```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(gtools)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(phangorn)
library(cowplot)

plot.theme<-theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  panel.background = element_rect("grey95"),
                  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                  text=element_text(size=10,face="bold"),
                  legend.text=element_text(size=8),
                  axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45,hjust=1,vjust=1))

# order legend categories by tree position, top to bottom (largest y in ggtree = top)
tip_order_breaks<-function(ggt, var){
  d<-ggt$data
  d<-d[d$isTip & !is.na(d[[var]]), ]
  d<-d[order(-d$y), ]
  unique(d[[var]])
}

# segment name (large bold) + n= + left-justified scale bar, all flush-left on x=0
add_seg_label<-function(p, tree, lab, seg.label.size=5.5, n.label.size=3.75, scale.label.size=3.5,
                        seg.label.yfrac=1.06, n.label.yfrac=1.02, scale.yfrac=0.2,
                        label.xfrac=0, text.xfrac=0.015, n.xfrac=0.03, scale.width=0.05){
  NN<-Ntip(tree)
  x_range<-max(node.depth.edgelength(tree))
  x0<-x_range*label.xfrac #scale bar anchor
  tx<-x_range*text.xfrac #title anchor
  nx<-x_range*n.xfrac #n= anchor, slightly right of title
  sw<-scale.width #fixed scale bar width (subs/site)
  scale_y<-ceiling(NN*scale.yfrac) #lower-left, above the tree bottom
  p +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,NN*1.1), clip="off") +
    annotate("segment", x=x0, xend=x0+sw, y=scale_y, yend=scale_y, linewidth=0.5) +
    annotate("text", x=x0, y=scale_y, label=sw, hjust=0, vjust=-0.6, size=scale.label.size) +
    annotate("text", x=tx, y=NN*seg.label.yfrac, label=lab,
             hjust=0, vjust=1, fontface="bold", size=seg.label.size) +
    annotate("text", x=nx, y=NN*n.label.yfrac, label=paste0("n=", NN),
             hjust=0, vjust=1, size=n.label.size)
}
```

## plot NA trees with N_type labels
```{r}
type.cols<-replicate(vector,n=l.tr)
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  #trees with tips colored by clade
  segment<-meta[[i]]$segment[1]
  #only run if it is the NA tree
  if(segment=="NA"|is.na(segment)){
    
  NN<-Ntip(trees[[i]])
  meta[[i]]<- meta[[i]][order(is.na(meta[[i]]$N_type)), ]
  meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]] %>% select(-any_of(c("X.2","X.1","X")))
  
  #use the same colors in plots below
  n.ntype<-length(table(meta[[i]]$N_type)) #excl NA
  if(n.ntype>7){type.cols[[i]]<-colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(name="Dark2",n=7))(n.ntype)}
  if(n.ntype<=7){type.cols[[i]]<-brewer.pal(name="Dark2",n=n.ntype)}
  names(type.cols[[i]])<-unique(meta[[i]]$N_type) %>% sort
  
  #basic tree
  t<-ggtree(trees[[i]])+
    geom_tree()

  # Add the Ntypes
  t <- t %<+% meta[[i]]
  ntype_order<-tip_order_breaks(t,"N_type") #legend ordered top to bottom of tree
  t$data$N_type[is.na(t$data$N_type) & t$data$isTip]<-"N/A" #show unlabelled tips in legend
  t$data$N_type<-factor(t$data$N_type, levels=c(ntype_order,"N/A")) #legend order; N/A last
  na_tips<-subset(t$data, isTip & N_type=="N/A") #missing-subtype tips
  cat("NA tree: N/A (missing subtype) tips =", nrow(na_tips), "of", sum(t$data$isTip), "\n")
  t2 <- t + geom_tippoint(aes(color = N_type),size=0.7,alpha=0.8) +
    geom_point(data=na_tips, aes(x=x, y=y, color=N_type), size=2, alpha=0.9) + #N/A drawn larger, on top
      theme(legend.position = c(0.05, 0.6),
            legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
            legend.title=element_text(face="bold", size=16.5),
            legend.key.size=unit(0.4,"cm"),
            legend.text=element_text(size=15.75)) +
    labs(color="NA type")+
    scale_color_manual(values=c(type.cols[[i]], "N/A"="grey70"),
                       breaks=c(ntype_order, "N/A"))+
    guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=2)))
  t2<-add_seg_label(t2, trees[[i]], "NA (original labels)")
  na_before_plot<-t2 #store for before/after composite
  t2; ggsave(paste0(f.out, "NA_NtypesTipColor_nofill.tiff"),
         width=5.5,height=7.5,units="in")
  } #if NA loop
}
```

## Propagate the NA types in the tree
note that this was inspired by the genoflu clades fill-in.
Also note that it looks like some NA types are wrong... (surrounded by other)
```{r}
# Post-order propagation function that propagates existing non-NA labels downward to missing tips. Only propagates if all non-NA labels in the current N_type are identical (monophyletic). Traverses the tree bottom-up (postorder) so smaller Ntypes are resolved first. libs ape and phangorn.
fill_N_types <- function(tree, tip_data, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  # Ensure tip_data matches tree tip order
  tip_data <- tip_data[match(tree$tip.label, tip_data$tip), ]
  # Step 1: Safe propagation (bottom-up)
  postorder_nodes <- rev(postorder(tree))
  internal_nodes <- postorder_nodes[postorder_nodes > Ntip(tree)]
  for (node in internal_nodes) {
    descendants <- Descendants(tree, node, type = "tips")[[1]]
    labels <- tip_data$N_type[descendants]
    nonNA_labels <- labels[!is.na(labels)]
    # Only propagate if all non-NA labels are identical
    if (length(nonNA_labels) > 0 && length(unique(nonNA_labels)) == 1) {
      tip_data$N_type[descendants][is.na(labels)] <- nonNA_labels[1] 
    }
  }
  
  # Step 2: Fill remaining NAs by nearest labeled tip
  na_tips <- which(is.na(tip_data$N_type))
  if (length(na_tips) > 0) {
    nonNA_idx <- which(!is.na(tip_data$N_type))
    # Compute pairwise tip distances
    dist_matrix <- cophenetic.phylo(tree)
    for (tip_idx in na_tips) {
      nearest_idx <- nonNA_idx[which.min(dist_matrix[tip_idx, nonNA_idx])]
      tip_data$N_type[tip_idx] <- tip_data$N_type[nearest_idx]
    }
  }
  return(tip_data)
}
```

#run and re-plot trees with new labels
```{r}
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  segment<-meta[[i]]$segment[1]
  #only run if it is the NA tree
  if(segment=="NA"|is.na(segment)){
    tip_data<-meta[[i]]%>% select(seq_new, N_type)
  colnames(tip_data)<-c("tip","N_type")
  set.seed(111) #randomly breaks ties
  filled_data<-fill_N_types(trees[[i]],tip_data)
  sum(is.na(filled_data$N_type)) 
  
  #attach clade_labels onto meta
  colnames(filled_data)[1]<-"seq_new"
  if(any(colnames(meta[[i]])=="N_type")){ #replace
    meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]][,-which(colnames(meta[[i]])=="N_type")]
  }
  meta[[i]]<-left_join(meta[[i]], filled_data, by="seq_new")
  
  #trees with tips colored by clade
  NN<-Ntip(trees[[i]])
  meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]] %>% select(-any_of(c("X.2","X.1","X")))

  t<-ggtree(trees[[i]])+
    geom_tree()
  
  # Add the N_type (new filled in)
  t <- t %<+% meta[[i]] 
  ntype_order<-tip_order_breaks(t,"N_type") #legend ordered top to bottom of tree
  t2 <- t + geom_tippoint(aes(color = N_type),size=0.7,alpha=0.85) +
      theme(legend.position = c(0.05, 0.6),
            legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
            legend.title=element_text(face="bold", size=16.5),
            legend.key.size=unit(0.4,"cm"),
            legend.text=element_text(size=15.75)) +
    labs(color="NA type")+
    scale_color_manual(values=type.cols[[i]], na.value="grey70", breaks=ntype_order)+
    guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=2)))
  t2<-add_seg_label(t2, trees[[i]], "NA (filled in)")
  t2; ggsave(paste0(f.out, "NA_NtypesTipColorFillednoNA.tiff"),
         width=5.5,height=7.5,units="in")

  #A (before) | B (after) composite, high res from the ggplot objects directly
  na_composite<-plot_grid(na_before_plot, t2, ncol=2)
  ggsave(paste0(f.out, segment,"_Ntypes_before-after.tiff"), na_composite,
         width=11,height=7.5,units="in",dpi=300,bg="white")
  }
}
```

# Fill in and plot H5_clades (only on HA tree)
```{r}
clade.cols<-replicate(vector,n=l.tr)
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  #trees with tips colored by clade
  segment<-meta[[i]]$segment[1]
  #only run if it is the NA tree
  if(is.na(segment)){next}
  if(segment=="HA"){
    
  NN<-Ntip(trees[[i]])
  meta[[i]]<- meta[[i]][order(is.na(meta[[i]]$clade)), ]
  meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]] %>% select(-any_of(c("X.2","X.1","X")))
  
  #use the same colors in plots below
  n.H5clade<-length(table(meta[[i]]$clade)) #excl NA
  if(n.H5clade>7){clade.cols[[i]]<-colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(name="Dark2",n=7))(n.H5clade)}
  if(n.H5clade<=7){clade.cols[[i]]<-brewer.pal(name="Dark2",n=n.H5clade)}
  names(clade.cols[[i]])<-unique(meta[[i]]$clade) %>% sort
  
  #basic tree
  t<-ggtree(trees[[i]])+
    geom_tree()

  # Add the H5clades
  t <- t %<+% meta[[i]]
  clade_order<-tip_order_breaks(t,"clade") #legend ordered top to bottom of tree
  t$data$clade[is.na(t$data$clade) & t$data$isTip]<-"N/A" #show unlabelled tips in legend
  t$data$clade<-factor(t$data$clade, levels=c(clade_order,"N/A")) #N/A is last level -> drawn last, on top
  t2 <- t + geom_tippoint(aes(color = clade),size=0.7,alpha=0.8) +
      theme(legend.position = c(0.05, 0.6),
            legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
            legend.title=element_text(face="bold"),
            legend.key.size=unit(0.4,"cm"),
            legend.text=element_text(size=10.5)) +
    labs(color="H5 clade")+
    scale_color_manual(values=c(clade.cols[[i]], "N/A"="grey70"),
                       breaks=c(clade_order, "N/A"))+
    guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=2), ncol=2))
  t2<-add_seg_label(t2, trees[[i]], "HA (original labels)")
  ha_before_plot<-t2 #store for before/after composite
  t2; ggsave(paste0(f.out, "HA_H5cladesTipColor_nofill.tiff"),
         width=6.5,height=8,units="in")
  } #if HA loop
}
```

## Propagate the NA clades in the tree
note that this was inspired by the genoflu clades fill-in.
Also note that it looks like some NA clades are wrong... (surrounded by other)
```{r}
# Post-order propagation function that propagates existing non-NA labels downward to missing tips. Only propagates if all non-NA labels in the current clade are identical (monophyletic). Traverses the tree bottom-up (postorder) so smaller H5clades are resolved first. libs ape and phangorn.
fill_clades <- function(tree, tip_data, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  # Ensure tip_data matches tree tip order
  tip_data <- tip_data[match(tree$tip.label, tip_data$tip), ]
  # Step 1: Safe propagation (bottom-up)
  postorder_nodes <- rev(postorder(tree))
  internal_nodes <- postorder_nodes[postorder_nodes > Ntip(tree)]
  for (node in internal_nodes) {
    descendants <- Descendants(tree, node)[[1]]
    labels <- tip_data$clade[descendants]
    nonNA_labels <- labels[!is.na(labels)]
    # Only propagate if all non-NA labels are identical
    if (length(nonNA_labels) > 0 && length(unique(nonNA_labels)) == 1) {
      tip_data$clade[descendants][is.na(labels)] <- nonNA_labels[1] 
    }
  }
  
  # Step 2: Fill remaining NAs by nearest labeled tip
  na_tips <- which(is.na(tip_data$clade))
  if (length(na_tips) > 0) {
    nonNA_idx <- which(!is.na(tip_data$clade))
    # Compute pairwise tip distances
    dist_matrix <- cophenetic.phylo(tree)
    for (tip_idx in na_tips) {
      nearest_idx <- nonNA_idx[which.min(dist_matrix[tip_idx, nonNA_idx])]
      tip_data$clade[tip_idx] <- tip_data$clade[nearest_idx]
    }
  }
  return(tip_data)
}
```

#run and re-plot trees with new labels
```{r}
i=1 #for HA
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  segment<-meta[[i]]$segment[1]
  #only run if it is the NA tree
  if(is.na(segment)){next}
  if(segment=="HA"){
    tip_data<-meta[[i]]%>% select(seq_new, clade)
    colnames(tip_data)<-c("tip","clade")
    set.seed(111) #randomly breaks ties
    filled_data<-fill_clades(trees[[i]],tip_data)
    sum(is.na(filled_data$clade)) 
  
    #attach clade_labels onto meta
    colnames(filled_data)[1]<-"seq_new"
    if(any(colnames(meta[[i]])=="clade")){ #replace
      meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]][,-which(colnames(meta[[i]])=="clade")]
    }
    meta[[i]]<-left_join(meta[[i]], filled_data, by="seq_new")
    
    #trees with tips colored by clade
    NN<-Ntip(trees[[i]])
    meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]] %>% select(-any_of(c("X.2","X.1","X")))
  
    t<-ggtree(trees[[i]])+
      geom_tree()
    
    # Add the clade (new filled in)
    t <- t %<+% meta[[i]] 
    clade_order<-tip_order_breaks(t,"clade") #legend ordered top to bottom of tree
    t2 <- t + geom_tippoint(aes(color = clade),size=0.7,alpha=0.85) +
        theme(legend.position = c(0.05, 0.6),
              legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
              legend.title=element_text(face="bold"),
              legend.key.size=unit(0.4,"cm"),
              legend.text=element_text(size=10.5)) +
      labs(color="H5 clade")+
      scale_color_manual(values=clade.cols[[i]], na.value="grey70", breaks=clade_order)+
      guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=2),ncol=2))
    t2<-add_seg_label(t2, trees[[i]], "HA (filled in)")
    t2; ggsave(paste0(f.out, "HA_H5cladesTipColorFillednoNA.tiff"),
           width=6.5,height=8,units="in")

    #A (before) | B (after) composite, high res from the ggplot objects directly
    ha_composite<-plot_grid(ha_before_plot, t2, ncol=2)
    ggsave(paste0(f.out, segment,"_H5clades_before-after.tiff"), ha_composite,
           width=13,height=8,units="in",dpi=300,bg="white")
  }
}
```

## Output the updated N_type and clade labels in meta (only once)
```{r}
# propagate the changes in NA meta to all meta, and the changes in HA meta to all meta
meta.filledin<-meta[[1]] %>% select(sample, clade)
meta.na<-meta[[3]] %>% select (sample, subtype, N_type)
meta.filledin<-left_join(meta.filledin, meta.na, by="sample")

write.csv(meta.filledin, paste0(f.out, "sample_filledin_N-type_HA-clade.csv"))
```
